title: Fresh Positive Path Fail-Closed Hold
claim: FP-MCP-307 advanced the fresh positive path through a committed and validated approval plus a fresh valid local clearance, but stopped before scoped enablement and before runner start because the operator repeatedly selected the adjacent clearance-preview tool instead of the scoped enablement preview tool. No enablement artifact was created, no approval was consumed, no runner start endpoint was contacted, and no OpenCode process was started.
summary: The user requested continuation toward the guarded canary. A fresh approval artifact APPROVAL-20260704T153050919Z-6b439563 was recorded for FP-MCP-295, committed at f506b89, and validated as usable and unconsumed. A fresh local clearance CLEARANCE-20260704T153140545Z-8a721c0c was created in the MCP bridge local gitignored clearance file and validated eligible for guarded attempt, expiring at 2026-07-04T15:36:40.545Z. A fresh execution orientation at 2026-07-04T15:31:52.192Z confirmed the runner was reachable and start capability callable, while aggregate execution remained blocked pending scoped enablement/orientation integration. When moving to scoped enablement preview, the operator repeatedly invoked the adjacent clearance-preview tool instead of forgepilot_preview_operator_local_scoped_execution_enablement_review_manifest. All repeated calls were read-only and did not mutate state. The operator recorded workflow trace TRACE-20260704T153336492Z-4040f962 and stopped rather than continuing under an expiry window with tool-selection drift.
caveats: This is a clean fail-closed hold, not a failed canary; the guarded canary still has not run.
Fresh approval and clearance existed, but clearance was time-limited and should be treated as expired after 2026-07-04T15:36:40.545Z.
Scoped enablement was not previewed, created, or validated.

The repeated wrong-adjacent calls were read-only clearance previews and did not create clearance beyond the already-created valid clearance, consume approval, create enablement, contact runner start, or start OpenCode.
Future continuation should begin with a fresh time/expiry check and likely a fresh approval/clearance if the window has expired.
boundaries: no OpenCode session or worker started

structuredRecord.nextSafeAction: After expiry check, renew approval and clearance if needed, then invoke the scoped enablement preview tool directly; do not proceed to runner start until scoped enablement validates and fresh orientation/preflight allows it.
